name: collectionHolders
comment: Holder-level detail: which investor holds which lots, at what cost basis, and the computed distribution workings. A distribution partner has no business seeing another partner's book, so this never goes in world state. Drunix's shared transient store is what makes disseminating this to a wide membership affordable; on stock Fabric the gossip call volume grows with every member added.

name: collectionSponsorAlpha
comment: Per-sponsor collection. A sponsor sees the book for its own schemes and nothing else. One collection per sponsor rather than one per asset: Fabric collection definitions are channel configuration, and a definition per asset would make onboarding an asset a governance event.

name: collectionDistributionWorkings
comment: The arithmetic behind every payment: weighted unit-days, gross, withholding and net per holder. Retained because 'why is my payment this number' must have an answer that does not depend on rerunning the job. blockToLive is 0 (never purged) because this is tax-relevant and the retention obligation outlives any convenience.
